quote: indicated for the treatment of mild to moderate dementia of the Alzheimer's type
note: Benzgalantamine's active moiety is galantamine and every supplied galantamine label names Alzheimer-type dementia as the indication.

quote: indicated for the treatment of panic disorder, with or without agoraphobia
note: The label treats panic disorder; panic attacks are only described as its defining manifestation, a reverse symptom swap.

quote: Systemic lupus erythematosus Acute rheumatic carditis
note: Only acute rheumatic carditis is indicated; generic heart-layer inflammation (carditis incl. infective endo/myo/pericarditis) is a much broader class.

quote: As pituitary TSH suppressants, in the treatment or prevention of various types of euthyroid goiters, including thyroid nodules, subacute or chronic lymphocytic thyroiditis (Hashimoto’s), multinodular goiter
note: One supplied label explicitly indicates euthyroid/multinodular goiter; the newer negation covers only nontoxic diffuse goiter in iodine-sufficient patients, and texts are a union.

quote: Phenobarbital controls anxiety, decreases muscular activity and lessens nervous excitability in hyperthyroid patients.
note: Phenobarbital sedates the anxiety/excitability manifestations of hyperthyroidism rather than treating the thyroid disease itself.
Labels indicate rheumatoid arthritis (joint disease) only; interstitial lung disease is never mentioned and RA-ILD is not a form of the arthritis being treated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)
note: Only ADHD is indicated; 'atypical behavior' is a broad behavioral phenotype category, and the warnings mention of behavior disturbance is not the basis for the claim.

quote: indicated for the treatment of mild-to-moderate dementia associated with Parkinson’s disease (PDD)
note: The label treats the dementia manifestation of Parkinson's disease, not Parkinson's disease itself.

quote: Ibuprofen Tablets, USP are indicated for relief of mild to moderate pain.
note: Generic mild-to-moderate pain indication covers testicular pain as a narrower specific form of pain.

quote: Nystatin and Triamcinolone Acetonide Cream and Ointment are indicated for the treatment of cutaneous candidiasis
note: The only antifungal indication is on the nystatin/triamcinolone combination and belongs to nystatin; elsewhere fungal infections appear only in warnings.

quote: in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus and established cardiovascular disease (CVD)
note: Cardiovascular disease appears literally as the population; the treated targets are specific MACE events, mirroring the rubric's CHD example.

quote: There are no controlled trials demonstrating risk reduction with quinapril tablets USP.
note: Stroke reduction is cited only as an antihypertensive class benefit and the label explicitly says it has not been demonstrated for quinapril.

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with acute myeloid leukemia (AML)
note: Myeloid leukemia is a near parent that essentially describes the indicated AML, not a whole organ-system or broad disease class.

quote: For the temporary relief of pain
note: The topical OTC indication is generic local pain relief, which covers scar pain as a narrower localized pain.

quote: Sympathetic ophthalmia, uveitis and ocular inflammatory conditions unresponsive to topical corticosteroids.
note: Ocular cicatricial pemphigoid is a specific ocular (conjunctival) inflammatory condition within the indicated corticosteroid-responsive class.

quote: in combination with other approved chemotherapeutic agents as first line treatment in patients with small cell lung cancer
note: Small cell lung cancer is indicated and the recurrent form is a narrower subtype; the first-line qualifier is not an explicit negation.

quote: Management of postherpetic neuralgia in adults
note: Gabapentin manages neuralgia following herpes zoster; the viral infection is only the past background, not the thing treated.

quote: A manic episode is a distinct period of abnormally and persistently elevated, expansive, or irritable mood.
note: Anger/irritability/hostility appear only as manifestations of mania, which is what valproate is indicated to treat.

quote: indicated in the treatment of serious infections caused by susceptible strains of the following microorganisms
note: Gentamicin is restricted to serious infections by susceptible bacteria; generic 'Infection' is a whole disease class including viral, fungal and parasitic infections.

quote: reduces the rate of progression of nephropathy as measured by the occurrence of doubling of serum creatinine or end stage renal disease
note: The label claims losartan reduces occurrence of end-stage renal disease in diabetic nephropathy, a prevention claim for ESRD.

quote: indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms (VMS) due to menopause
note: Treating vasomotor symptoms of menopause manages the menopausal syndrome, and artificially induced menopause is a narrower form not excluded.

quote: indicated in adults for the management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatments are inadequate
note: Management of a disease's pain counts per the rubric, and CRPS pain falls under the generic severe-pain indication.

quote: indicated for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH, WHO Group I)
note: Only PAH is indicated; 'heart disorder' is an organ-system category, with congenital heart disease mentioned only as clinical-study background.

quote: Deficient spermatogenesis due to hypogonadotrophic hypogonadism.
note: The EMA text treats deficient spermatogenesis (and infertility) caused by hypogonadism, not the hypogonadism itself.
